# First-useful-drawing marks

First useful drawing is the time from navigation start to the first frame that shows geometry. The table is the baseline: a MapLibre map without the add-on, so the add-on has a number to be compared against. The add-on's own mark needs the remote source with real `.pvec` bytes and is not measured yet (see [deferred work](deferred.md), issue 50). The mark is therefore not claimed.
